releaseNotes:
SecApper Live Update v1.1.4:
• Windows 11 Multi-Tab Explorer Support: Fixed unlock popup interception in Windows 11 File Explorer by actively enumerating top-level dialogs across XAML island tabs.
• Removed Style Constraints: Accommodates modern Windows 11 dialog and TaskDialog window styles without legacy WS_POPUP style restrictions.
• Enhanced DirectUI Dismissal: Gracefully closes Windows 11 error prompts using UI Automation Cancel invoke and WM_CLOSE without hanging Explorer.
• Force Foreground Enhancement: Uses SetWindowPos (HWND_TOPMOST) and AllowSetForegroundWindow to guarantee the unlock popup always appears directly on top in Windows 11.
• Automatic Re-Lock & Reliable Repeated Double-Clicks: Works seamlessly across repeated attempts on both Windows 10 and Windows 11.
